description: Implement Home/Discover screen and Profile screen with real Supabase data fetching, premium UI components, and full functionality.
steps: Create lib/features/home/screens/home_screen.dart - premium discover/home screen with: greeting header with user avatar, search bar, featured campaigns carousel (horizontal scroll with cards), category filter chips, trending creators section, recent campaigns grid. All data fetched from Supabase.

Create lib/features/home/widgets/campaign_card.dart - premium campaign card widget with image, brand avatar, title, budget, deadline, platform icon, slots indicator. Rounded corners, subtle shadows, shimmer loading state.
Create lib/features/home/widgets/creator_card.dart - compact creator card for horizontal list: avatar, name, category, followers count, rating stars
Create lib/features/home/widgets/category_chips.dart - horizontal scrollable filter chips for campaign categories (Fashion, Tech, Food, Beauty, Fitness, Travel, Gaming, etc.)
Create lib/features/home/providers/home_provider.dart - Riverpod providers to fetch featured campaigns, trending creators, filtered campaigns from Supabase

Create lib/features/profile/screens/profile_screen.dart - premium profile screen with: large avatar with edit button, name, handle, role badge, bio, stats row (campaigns, earnings, rating for creators OR campaigns posted, total spent for brands), action buttons (Edit Profile, KYC Status, Settings), menu items list (Wallet, Orders, Notifications, Help, Logout)
Create lib/features/profile/screens/edit_profile_screen.dart - edit profile form with image picker for avatar, text fields for name/handle/bio/phone, save to Supabase
Create lib/features/profile/providers/profile_provider.dart - Riverpod providers for current user profile data, update profile, upload avatar
Create lib/core/widgets/shimmer_loading.dart - reusable shimmer placeholder widgets for loading states
Create lib/core/widgets/premium_card.dart - base card widget with premium styling (subtle gradient border, shadow, rounded corners)
Create lib/core/widgets/avatar_widget.dart - circular avatar with cached network image, placeholder, and optional online indicator
Create lib/core/widgets/stat_chip.dart - small stat display widget (icon + number + label)
acceptance_criteria: Home screen displays a greeting with user's name from Supabase
Home screen fetches and displays campaigns from Supabase campaigns table
Campaign cards show title, brand, budget, deadline, and slot count
Profile screen displays current user data from Supabase users table
Profile screen shows role-appropriate stats (creator vs brand)
Edit profile screen updates user data in Supabase
Shimmer loading states appear while data is being fetched
All screens use the premium theme (orange-red accent, white background, custom fonts)
No placeholder/dummy data - all data comes from Supabase queries
verification: Read lib/features/home/screens/home_screen.dart and verify Supabase query calls
Read lib/features/profile/screens/profile_screen.dart and verify user data display
Read lib/features/home/providers/home_provider.dart and verify Supabase table references match schema
Verify all widget files have proper build methods and return valid widget trees
